fields.kind: joint mass, material provenance and force transfer
fields.note: Candidate-multiplier joint sizing is correct, including quadratic mass. At the headline, 44.191468267 kg and 1.258252477 axial/bond multipliers are consequences of equal-stress design, without extra reserve. Legacy Toray supports 1470 MPa but does not establish 1550 kg/m3 composite density. Henkel's 28.9 MPa datum is prepared aluminum, not SiC. Percent-joint cases have unknown capacity; sub-unity Ti cases size below operating demand.
fields.settle: Pin density and laminate/manufacturing specification; verify ceramic adhesion, peel, load spreading, moment transfer and rotational stiffness; include adhesive and attachment mass.
